page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a running head at the top and a catchword at the lower right. No margin notes are printed.

main_text.p: pore auidius euoluenda inflammare possint. Ta-les esse iudico Tertulliani Apologeticum: Cypriani tractatum contra Demetrianum: Ambrosij (alij Prospero tribuunt) libellos de vocatione gentium: Augustini Enchiridion ad Laurentium, libellos de doctrina Christiana: & quaedam posteriora Tomi septimi opuscula: Fulgentij librum primum ad Monimum, : Damasceni libros de Orthodoxa fide: Socratis historiam Ecclesiasti-cam,&c.

Sed, quod dixi, finem nunc facio. Oro autem, Deum aeternum Patrem, Domini nostri Iesu Christi toto pectore, ut sanam verbi sui doctrinam, quam in Ecclesiis Palatinatus pro immensa sua bonitate accendit, puram putamque seruare clementer dignetur: benedicat insuper florentis-simae huic Academiae, cuius ciuem me factum esse, merito gaudeo, & nos omnes faciat organa mise-ricordiae salutaria: ad laudem gloriosi nominis sui, & ad aedificationem Ecclesiae suae, per eundem Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum, cui honor & gloria in secula.

page.notes: Faint pencil-like marks at the left margin beside the first line and beside "Sed" are not printed text and are left out. Show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page at the right edge are left out. The printer's hook sign at several line ends (after "autem", "Patrem", "Monimum", "Ecclesiasti-cam") is read as a comma; its exact value is slightly uncertain. The catchword "PRÆ-" is the start of the next page's word.
